cleanup.note: Release was delegated to run_gate's exact-identity stop primitive; the harness sent no signals and never guessed a PGID.

limitations: Scope is local-host runner entry only: no Hub service, Gateway, fleet node, Production queue or Mac pause state was used or changed.
This qualification is entrypoint integration only; it does not re-qualify the already source-bound stop primitive.
The packaged six-command fixture is unmodified; the runner adds its own -I -B to the first recipe argv.
preempt_check was a synthetic local callback driven by the scratch READY marker; this is not a Production preemption proof.
Preemption waits until the runner's own real Metrics.tree call has observed the ignoring child; READY alone does not stop it.
The Library fixture sourceCommit d9c9505 identifies the packaged Library archive, not Hub source; Hub runner sources are pinned by sha256 here.
Runner-internal sampled descendants are not exposed by run_gate; checked identities are the identity_recorder leader plus descendants sampled by the runner's real Metrics.tree calls.
stop_latency_seconds is measured from the harness's preempt trigger to run_gate return, including the runner's bounded stop and drain; it is not a primitive-only latency.
Only the first fixture command's harmless Python toy was executed; the node and go commands were not run, and no Library source was extracted or run.
Scratch and evidence are retained; the harness sent no signals and never guessed a PGID. Release was delegated to run_gate's exact-identity stop primitive.
Actual qualification needs an interpreter with psutil for the real Metrics adapter (the voice app runtime is one); a missing psutil is reported as metrics_unavailable, never faked.
